scoring_justification: Direct result-level comparison against paper-reported gold values with tolerances; recomputation from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values and tolerances for segregation energies and related quantities
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Physical Review Letters 69, 3330 (1992). Values extracted from the main text and Fig. 3: As binding ~0.1 eV, As+ binding ~0.03 eV, Ga binding ~0 eV, relaxation energies ~50 meV, ionization shift ~80 meV, bulk As binding 13 meV, interface band ~10 meV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken directly from the paper's reported results, converted to meV. The reference solve.sh embeds these exact numbers to guarantee full-reward reachability.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's measured headline quantities, verifiable by reading the paper.

outputs.description: All key quantitative results: segregation energies for neutral As, ionized As+, and Ga; relaxation energy components; ionization potential increase for As on boundary; bulk donor binding energy; interface electron band energy. All values in meV.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run all DFT calculations and derive these quantities from total energies. The hidden gold values come from the paper's reported results (~0.1 eV As binding, ~0.03 eV As+, ~0 meV Ga, ~13 meV bulk binding, ~80 meV ionization shift, ~10 meV interface band). Tolerances accommodate pseudopotential differences.
